basic_info.description: Ideally situated between the Valencia Corridor and Castro Village, 3559 17th Street is a rarely available condo in an established 5-unit HOA comprised of two buildings. The full-floor flat is the lower unit in an Edwardian building with separate entrance.  The bright, updated one-bedroom home features beautiful original details including a bay window with window seat, wainscoting, built-ins, a legacy Murphy bed, and hardwood floors throughout. A spacious eat-in kitchen has been renovated with stone counters, subway tiles, Bertazzoni range, and stainless-steel appliances. A sunny home office opens onto the rear stairs. The vintage bathroom has a shower over a clawfoot tub. A central lightwell illuminates the hallway and main living space and provides verdant outlooks. At garage level, there is a common laundry room, one-car parking, and additional storage. This charming condo is in a congenial, self-managed HOA with $200 monthly dues which cover water, garbage, building insurance, and common area utilities and maintenance. The prime location is steps from Valencia Corridor and Castro Village shopping, restaurants, and entertainment, and offers numerous public transportation options.
